title: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane
summary: Jesus obeyed the Father even when the path was painful. Jesus prayed in Gethsemane before His arrest. When obedience feels painful, Jesus' prayer shows honest sorrow and surrender to the Father.

read_it.prompt: Read Matthew 26:36-46. Watch for what the story shows about prayer.

tell_it: Jesus prayed in Gethsemane before His arrest. Jesus prayed in the garden before the cross. He honestly brought His sorrow to the Father and submitted to His will.
understand_it: The point is not that Jesus Prays in Gethsemane is impressive by itself. Jesus obeyed the Father even when the path was painful. When obedience feels painful, Jesus' prayer shows honest sorrow and surrender to the Father.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus prayed in Gethsemane before His arrest.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus prayed in the garden before the cross. He honestly brought His sorrow to the Father and submitted to His will. Kids can notice prayer in the choices people make, not only in the famous part of the story. Jesus obeyed the Father even when the path was painful.
teen_explanation: Jesus obeyed the Father even when the path was painful. When obedience feels painful, Jesus' prayer shows honest sorrow and surrender to the Father. Teens can also notice the tension in the passage: faith is not always easy, immediate, or admired by everyone nearby.
key_truths: Jesus obeyed the Father even when the path was painful.
Jesus Prays in Gethsemane shows prayer through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When obedience feels painful, Jesus' prayer shows honest sorrow and surrender to the Father.
life_application: When obedience feels painful, Jesus' prayer shows honest sorrow and surrender to the Father.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer belongs to Jesus Prays in Gethsemane?
choices: The disciples stayed awake all night
Peter made the decision for Jesus
quiz_questions.explanation: Gethsemane is the correct answer. The detail matters because it keeps the lesson tied to Matthew 26:36-46, not just a general idea.

quiz_questions.question: What is one wise response to Jesus Prays in Gethsemane?
quiz_questions.answer: When obedience feels painful, Jesus' prayer shows honest sorrow and surrender to the Father.
quiz_questions.explanation: The lesson should move from hearing to response. Jesus obeyed the Father even when the path was painful.

memory_verse.prompt: Use Matthew 26:39 as the verse anchor for Jesus Prays in Gethsemane.

discussion_questions: What happened first in Jesus Prays in Gethsemane, and what changed by the end?
Where do you see prayer in Jesus Prays in Gethsemane?
What is one small choice Jesus Prays in Gethsemane could shape this week?

activity.title: Cup of Surrender
activity.instructions: Draw a cup and write one hard but right choice to bring to God in prayer.

prayer_prompt: Father, help me see what Jesus Prays in Gethsemane teaches and practice prayer in a real choice this week.
